objective: Keep the existing simple monthly formula fixed; compare published Top32 versus Top35 for the existing 44 months, then extend both to the 69 author-ledger periods starting 2020-12-31.
normalization: Within the complete contemporaneous stock-plus-core17 universe, scale each feature from its 10th to 90th percentile, clip to [0,1], subtract 0.5. Retain the previous eligibility gate and stable lexical tie breaks.
gate: 295 consecutive valid adjusted close sessions and P[t-42]/P[t-252]-1 > 0.
portfolio: 3 equal-weight positions; exactly 2 eligible positions get equal halves; fewer than 2 remain cash. Monthly fixed shares, rebalance differences at month-end close.
ranking_expansion: All ranks 33-35 enter at every decision date, not only author-selected winners. Issuer deduplication precedes the rank cutoff.
recent_source: Existing corrected 44 published monthly rankings; Top32 must exactly reproduce the previous daily equity and holdings control.
earlier_source: Cached issuer-wide historical capitalization observations, historical US listing evidence, and source-aligned prior prices; collect missing relevant free sources as needed. Keep observation dates, dates used, corrections and limitations in a separate manifest. No old index-constrained pool is substituted.
availability: Earlier reconstructed rankings use observations no later than the previous trading session, rolled by split-consistent price ratios when necessary. Historical vendor revision/publication vintages remain unverified.
coverage_audit: Independent historical global large-company references only cross-check candidate coverage and cap units, never replace the monthly pool or provide future ranking membership.
reporting: Separate unchanged published44 comparison from extended69 research comparison. Explain the earlier universe reconstruction and any remaining historical coverage uncertainty. Author ledger is simulated learning material, not verified actual trading.
protected: No changes to existing research outputs, rules, weights, ledgers, frozen plans, monitoring code, or automation. New files only in this experiment directory.
